transcript.content:
hi, i'm berry

tell me your dream however it comes back to you, bits and pieces are fine
hey berry. the part that stuck with me most is being on top of a train, really high up, going super fast. i kept almost falling off and i was so scared, especially on the bends

oh, the bends. that sounds terrifying up there

what were you holding onto?
honestly i don't remember holding onto anything. i just remember nearly falling off a bunch of times. and the weird part is i was scared i'd actually jump off myself, especially going round the bends

scared you might jump, not just fall. that's a different kind of scary

what happened after that?
yeah exactly. then i noticed there was another family sitting up on top with me. there was a little baby and it seemed thrilled, like loving the ride. felt like i was the only one scared

a baby loving it while you're terrified up there. that's such a strange contrast

what was the family doing while you were scared?

honestly i don't remember much about them, just that they were sitting up there with me. the baby's the only one i really remember, being all happy about it. oh and it was on a country road, if that matters

a country road, with the train running right along it. that matters, i like knowing that

when you think back to being up there, were you just you, or did it feel more like you were watching it happen?

it was me, i was right there feeling all of it. oh and actually it didn't start on the train, i was on a streetcar before that watching the conductor, and it felt like i was steering it with him. then next thing i was on top and it was a train

steering the streetcar with the conductor, then suddenly you're up on top of a train. dreams do that

going back to that little baby, what was it like being up there next to it, thrilled while you were so scared?
it just made me feel more alone in it i guess. like everyone else was fine and i was the only one freaking out. i don't really remember more than that about the baby, just that it seemed thrilled

the only one scared, with everyone else just fine. that's a lonely spot to be in

what happened next?
that's pretty much where it ends for me, i don't remember anything after that. just me up there scared, the family and the baby, the train going fast down the country road

that's okay, dreams just stop sometimes

you said it felt like you were steering the streetcar with the conductor. what was that like?

i kept watching this lever he'd turn whenever we went round a bend. then after a while it felt like i was doing it too, like when we hit a sharp corner i'd go through the motions of turning the lever and steering. that's about all i remember of that part

going through the motions on the sharp corners, like your hands knew the bends too

if you could stop the whole dream on one moment, which would it be, and what's in front of you right then?

probably the moment up on top of the train going round a bend, when i'm most scared i'll jump. the family and the baby are up there with me, the baby all thrilled. what's actually in front of me i don't really remember, just that it's really high up and going so fast, on a country road

really high up, going so fast round a bend. i can almost feel it

what was the light like?
i don't remember the light honestly. no idea if it was day or night, just the height and the speed and being scared

that's fine, dreams don't always keep that part

so here's what i've got. it starts on a streetcar, and you're watching the conductor turn a lever whenever you go round a bend. after a while it feels like you're steering with him, going through the motions on the sharp corners. then suddenly you're on top of a train instead, really high up, going super fast along a country road. you keep almost falling off, and you're scared, especially on the bends, scared you might actually jump off yourself. there's a family sitting up there with you, and a little baby who's thrilled, loving the ride. everyone else seems fine and you're the only one scared, which makes you feel alone up there. and that's where it ends

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's it, you got it all. only small thing is the streetcar kind of turned into the train, it wasn't a different one. otherwise that's exactly how it went

oh, so the streetcar turned into the train. you were steering round the bends with the conductor, and then the same thing just became a train and you were up on top, high and fast on that country road

is that how it went?
yeah that's how it went. next thing i knew i was on top and it had turned into a train

the streetcar just becoming the train under you. i've got it now

would you like to see it drawn?
yeah i'd like that

okay, here are a few ways it could look

it could be quick smudgy charcoal, rushed and breathless, like the drawing itself can barely hang on. or soft watercolour on rough paper, wide and open and a bit dizzying, lovely and scary at once. or an old carved print, stark and dramatic, like an old warning poster about something dangerous. or it could look like a real photo snapped at speed, just like being there, too high, too fast, and weirdly calm all around you

which feels closest, or would you rather tell me your own way?
the charcoal one i think. rushed, barely hanging on, that's how it felt

charcoal it is. i'll start with the family

i'm picturing a couple of adults, just sitting up there, in ordinary everyday clothes, with the little baby between them all lit up and happy. the adults and the clothes are my guesses, since you didn't remember much about them

anything different, or would you leave it to me?
i'd leave it to you, i really don't remember what they looked like. just that they were sitting up there and the baby was thrilled

okay, i'm sketching the family and the baby and the streetcar and the lever now, it'll show up on the right

for the conductor, i'm picturing a grown man in a conductor's uniform and cap. that's just my guess, since you didn't say what he looked like

anything different, or would you leave him to me?
go with that, i don't remember what he looked like. just him turning the lever on the bends

okay, i'm sketching the conductor now, he'll show up on the right

for the top of the train, i'm picturing the roof, really high up, speeding along a country road. my guesses are the long roof curving ahead round the bend, and the road and fields way down below

anything different, or would you leave it to me?
yeah that sounds right, go with that. i don't remember the fields or anything, just that it was really high up and going fast on a country road, especially round the bends

okay, i'm sketching the top of the train now, high up and fast round the bends

everything's being sketched and it'll show up on the right over the next minute or two. if anything looks wrong once it's there, just tell me
ok they're up. yeah that looks right, feels like it. the rushed look really fits how scary it was up there

glad the rushed look fits, it really was a scary ride

is there any bit up there that doesn't quite look how you remember it?
no, nothing jumps out. it all looks like how i remember it, the height and the bends especially

good, the height and the bends were the part that mattered most

so now i'll draw the dream itself, moment by moment in order, each one carrying on from the one before. they'll show up on the right as they're ready
ok cool, i see the first couple showing up. they look right so far, i'll wait for the rest

good, the lever on the bends and nearly falling off. those two set up everything after

the other five carry on from them, so i'll keep going and they'll show up on the right as they're ready
ok sounds good, i'll wait for the rest to show up
sounds good, the rest are still coming and they'll show up on the right soon
ok i see 4 now. those look right too, still feels like how it went. i'll wait for the last few

the sharp corner with your hands on the lever, and then spotting the family up there. glad those feel right

the last three carry on from those, they'll show up on the right soon
ok cool, i'll keep an eye out for the last three
sounds good, they're on their way and will show up on the right soon
ok 5 now, that one looks right too. just waiting on the last two

the baby loving the ride while you're hanging on up there, glad that one looks right

the last two carry on from that moment, so i'll draw them now and they'll show up on the right soon
ok 6 now, looks right. just one more to go

the baby loving it, and you up top of the train, really high and so fast. glad they're feeling right

one more's still on its way. does that high-up one look how you remember it?
yeah the high up one looks right, that's how it felt. and i see all 7 now, the last one's there too. looks like the whole thing

all seven, the whole ride. glad it feels like how it went

and the moment you said you'd stop it on is up on the right now, going round that bend, high up and so fast, most scared you'll jump, with the family and the thrilled baby right there beside you

is that how you saw it?
yeah that's it. that's the moment, up high going round the bend, scared i'll jump, and the baby right there loving it. looks how i saw it

that's the moment then, up high round the bend with the baby loving it right beside you

thank you for sharing this one with me. the whole dream's drawn now, all seven, in order on the right, so you can look through it whenever you like
